The server offers three prompts. A client shows them as commands the user runs; in Claude Code they are [slash commands](/docs/reference/slash-commands/). Arguments are listed in the order the server declares them.

## destroy

Destroy all infrastructure in a workspace

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** plan · full

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | no | Path to the HCL configuration directory. Without one, the agent asks which directory. |
| `instructions` | no | Optional freeform instructions to steer this teardown, e.g. "only destroy module.staging". Honored within the normal plan/approve flow; they never bypass the destroy confirmation. |

## guide

Get started with Turf — a hands-on, use-case walkthrough on real examples

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `topic` | no | Optional journey to open directly: deploy AICR, day-2 maintenance, installer, promotion, TACO, or guardrails |

## up

Deploy or reconcile infrastructure from an HCL configuration directory

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** plan · full

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | no | Path to the HCL configuration directory. Without one, the agent asks which directory. |
| `instructions` | no | Optional freeform instructions to steer this deploy, e.g. "replace aws_s3_bucket.assets" or "only touch module.network". Honored within the normal plan/approve flow; they never bypass approval. |
